summary: Digital information creation and access are improved for users in low-resource settings through Project Saral, an OCR-plus application that structures physical input data. This enables users to upload data onto a backend in a structured format via a scan. The solution aims to reduce manual data entry and increase data accuracy. The beneficiaries of this project are likely individuals and organizations in developing regions with limited digital infrastructure. Project Saral addresses the sector of education and potentially other areas where digital information is crucial.
